notes: Source is Barco's own product datasheet (last updated 22 Jun 2023), mirrored by a reseller since www.barco.com/en/product/barco-alchemy-icmp-x returned HTTP 403 to automated fetch. The ICMP-X is a plug-in Integrated Cinema Media Processor module for Barco Alchemy Series 2/4 digital cinema projectors, not a standalone rack appliance — it draws power from the host projector's card-cage backplane via an internal edge connector, so no standalone AC/DC power port is listed and rackUnits is omitted. Datasheet confirms port counts/types (2x HDMI2.0a in, 2x 3G-SDI in, 16x AES/EBU audio on 2x RJ45, 8x GPI + 8x GPO on 4x RJ45, 2x GbE, 2x USB3.0 + 2x USB2.0 front) but does not give legible rear-panel silkscreen text; individual port names (HDMI 1/2, SDI 1/2, Audio A/B, GPIO A-D) follow Barco's typical ICMP panel labeling convention and are inferred, as are the AES/EBU ports being output-only (feeding the theater sound processor) and the GPIO RJ45 breakouts being bidirectional. HDMI grade taken as HDMI 2.0 per "HDMI2.0a" spec text; SDI grade taken as 3G per "3G-SDI" spec text; Ethernet grade taken as 1G per "Gbe" spec text; USB 3.0 grade mapped to usb-5g (SuperSpeed 5Gbps).
